title: console(marketplace): Installed Apps shows a package the runtime refused to load as installed — render the listing's not-loaded marker (the console half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#21822)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21822

Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. It is the foreseen console half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#21822. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

## Why
- After a restart whose rehydrate refused a protocol-incompatible package, `GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` lists it like any installed package. Setup → Installed Apps therefore shows it as installed, while the runtime has not loaded it (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21822, measured on PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21820).
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#21822 is graded to add a not-loaded marker on the listed entry, carrying the refusal's code (`OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`) and the declared range. The entry is kept in the list, so DELETE and a compatible re-install stay reachable.

## The step (after objectstack-ai/objectstack#21822 lands and the console pin carries it)
- `InstalledListWidget` renders the marker: the row reads "not loaded", names the reason in plain words, and keeps Uninstall.
- Details does not offer actions that need a loaded package.
- A loadable entry renders as today.

## Done when
A refused entry reads "not loaded" with its reason, and Uninstall works from that row. This is pinned against the server's marker shape as landed.

## Grade
`bug` · `priority:p2` (inherits objectstack-ai/objectstack#21822) · `domain:ui` · `area:devpath` · `pm:blocked`.
